evidence: recorded from the legacy single-file game before its retirement; no later source reads these files

course.name: Switchback Garden
course.desc: Six chambers in one arena. Bank shots around walls and a pond; the camera warps to the next putt.

course.name: Dune Serpent
course.desc: Six sandy chambers. Sand drags the ball, so bank shots need real power.

course.name: Frost Hollow
course.desc: Six frozen chambers. Ice keeps the ball sliding, so the walls are your brakes.

course.name: Slime Springs
course.desc: Six sticky chambers. Slime swallows speed, jump pads fling the ball over walls and teleporters skip the gaps.

course.name: Cyclone Ring
course.desc: Six windy chambers. Fans shove the ball sideways and tornadoes spin it, so aim for the calm outer ring.

course.name: Grand Finale
course.desc: Six final chambers. Portals, fans, ice, slime, jump pads and tornadoes all at once, with the smallest cups on the course.
